question: What were the most common types of Montgomery 311 requests in 2025?

answer.sql: SELECT category, SUM(value) AS record_count, SUM(SUM(value)) OVER () AS total_records, 100.0*SUM(value)/SUM(SUM(value)) OVER () AS share_pct FROM fw_pg.tract_observations WHERE run_id='r_20261026_54d143' AND source='m1_city' GROUP BY category ORDER BY record_count DESC, category

points: Nuisance was the most common request type with 7,170 records, representing 25.8% of all 311 requests in 2025.
Ask 3-1-1 ranked second with 3,321 requests (11.9% of the total).
Inquiries ranked third with 1,229 requests (4.4% of the total).

The top 10 request types also included Parking On Front Lawn (1,038), Traffic Issues for Montgomery Police Dept (681), FAQ-Municipal Court (612), Leaves and Debris Pick up (538), Clean Inlets (536), and FAQ-Montgomery Police Department (525).

Ties appeared at several ranks: Request Vacation Home Check and Sidewalk tied at 30th with 166 each; Request A New Container and Utility Issues tied at 44th with 93 each; and COM Roofing, Community Center Plumbing, and Sinkholes/Cave Ins tied at 48th with 78 each.
The data covers 27,817 total 311 requests received between January 1 and September 30, 2025; the 3-month gap (October–December) means full-year coverage is not established.
caveats: Only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2025) have source records; October–December are not confirmed zeros, so the total 27,817 is not a full-year count.
Ties in rank are explicitly noted; adjacent rows with equal values share a rank, but the tie_groups field in the data defines the exact grouping.
The ranking uses raw counts; no rate-per-population or per-capita adjustment is applied.
Some request names are lengthy or include usage disclaimers (e.g., DO NOT USE); these are preserved as they appear in the source.
answer.headline: The top 311 request types in Montgomery in 2025 were led by Nuisance (7,170 requests), Ask 3-1-1 (3,321), and Inquiries (1,229).
answer.how_sure: The ranking is based on raw request counts from the City of Montgomery's 311 system; 250 request categories are listed, with the top 3 accounting for over 42% of all records.
